evidence: The Fear & Greed Index plunged abruptly from greed levels of 64 on October 10 down to 27 and then 24 (Extreme Fear) on October 12. Such a sharp collapse indicates severe negative momentum and panicking market sentiment. While extreme fear occasionally sets up contrarian reversal opportunities over medium-term horizons, the immediate 24-hour window following an acute sentiment shock tends to experience continued downward pressure or volatile consolidation, tilting the short-term directional odds slightly below neutral.
limitations: Sentiment indices act as lagging or coincident measures of market momentum and do not guarantee directional price movements over a single 24-hour interval.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
